name: workspace

metadata.description: Unused files, exports and dependencies across the workspaces (knip.jsonc). Gated at zero: fix the finding, or add an ignore with a reason.

$comment: The workspace root and the nx release project. `nx release version` counts a commit toward the version when it affects a release project or a project one depends on, so this list holds every project that is part of the released app or its build, the UI (ui) and the Go shell (desktop) included: a push that only changes them must still produce a Windows build. The site (web) stays out, and so do docs-only pushes. scripts/ci/projects.test.mjs keeps the list complete. Per-project targets live in each project.json.
